author: Engineer Tchzevrak (rendered into Tamrielic)
pages: Day 12. The pressure doors hold. The hall below the water is dry and the lamps burn steady. The surface delegation said it could not be done. The delegation drowned on the way down, so I suppose they were right in their own way.
Day 30. The pumps are quiet. The sea outside leans on the dome but cannot come in, because a closed door is a wall and an open door is still a door. Children understand this. Architects do not.
Day 61. Something taps on the glass at night. I have stopped looking. The spiders are set to guard the hall. If anyone reads this: press the stud by the door, step through, and close it behind you.
